name: Mightwrapup
description: The thrower stands as the hawk waits, weight forward and cords hanging loose, for the target to commit.

name: Aegis Cordthree
description: Arms spread and the cords hang like mantled wings, shielding the thrower's flanks from a rush.

name: Stonescourge
description: The leading weight taps the target's hand sharply, as a hawk tests its prey before the strike.

name: Remnant Heavyball
description: From a high still perch the thrower reads the whole field and marks which foe will break first.

name: Fastening Wrapup
description: A stooping cast wraps the legs and the thrower hauls back in the same motion to recover the weights.

name: Chime Cordfork
description: The cord turns light as a feather at the moment of contact and slides a blow off to one side.

name: Gyvebola
description: Two weights clamp the opponent's wrists together like a pair of talons and qi locks the cords.

name: Shackle Ruin
description: The weights hover in a slow orbit about the foe and press him back with feints until he tires.

name: Decimating Tripcord Scourge
description: One piercing plunge of the iron-cored weight breaks the guard and the second cord binds the struck leg.

name: Gust Ballsling
description: The thrower stands with a weight orbiting each hand like water turning in a basin.

name: Impenetrable Joinknot
description: Both wrists roll their cords together and the double circle turns aside stones and darts.

name: Stoneruin
description: Both weights are flung together low and strike the two shins at the same instant.

name: Grievous Stonehead
description: The outer edge of the orbit lashes out and raps the opponent's forearm.

name: Overbearing Whirlcast
description: The two orbits close on a single limb from opposite sides and qi draws them together.

name: Thornhobble
description: Both cords drag a snared foe along the ground like silt toward the basin floor.

name: Siltorb
description: The thrower slides sideways with both orbits intact and arrives at a new angle of attack.

name: Granite Hobble
description: Two orbits widen into a double ring that lashes every opponent standing near the thrower.

name: Bolaweight Durance
description: The orbit reverses at the instant of impact and sends a thrown weapon back along its path.

name: Decimating Downpour Spindle
description: Both orbits burst past their rim in one tremendous sweep that topples all within the cords' reach.

name: Facetbola
description: Two weights leave the hand in the same pull and fly on slightly different arcs to the target.

name: Verity Stonehead
description: The thrower reads the open sky behind the target to judge its distance by the line of its shoulders.

name: Stonenerve
description: The pair of weights is brought together before the face to stop a thrown stone.

name: Thornbola
description: The pair of cords winds around the legs from opposite sides and qi seats the knots.

name: Toxin Wrapup
description: One weight takes the opponent's blade and the other wraps the hand behind it.

name: Might Cordthree
description: Both weights drop in a short steep stoop and strike the collarbone from either side.

name: Fetterhavoc
description: Two qi-charged weights fall from a high arc and land on the target's head and shoulders at once.

name: Stonevalor
description: Cords are staked in a lattice over open ground that snares every foot crossing the pattern.

name: Stoneglimmer
description: One weight snapped to a distant post draws the thrower across the gap faster than the eye can follow.

name: Torrent Bindfall
description: The thrower stands with each foot on its own line like the two banks of a river.

name: Nova Knotcenter
description: The throw begins with an even walking pace and flows into the release without a stop.

name: Mastering Fetter
description: Both cords are gathered hand over hand and drawn in together so the snare tightens evenly.

name: Gustfetter
description: A small quick rap of the weight sends a ripple of pain up the opponent's arm.

name: Fastening Fetter
description: Two cords flow around the foe like two currents and meet again behind his knees.

name: Mayhem Spindle
description: A sudden hard pull from below drags the foe's lead foot out from under him like an undertow.

name: Chime Heavyball
description: The cords meet the blow from two sides at once and it slips between them.

name: Slag Tripcord
description: The cords fan out like the arms of a river delta and tangle the feet of everyone before the thrower.

name: Intentstone
description: The thrower casts one cord, binds with the second, strikes with the first, and joins both again in a closing pull.

name: Immobilizing Bolaweight
description: A flood of qi runs down both cords and binds the foe so heavily that his strength drains to nothing.

name: Torrential Knotcenter
description: The thrower sets each hand on its own track, ready to cast two lines at once.

name: Fetterscourge
description: The left hand throws alone along its track while the right waits with its weight.

name: Lacerating Hobble
description: The right hand throws a breath behind the left and the two cords meet at the target's knees.

name: Torrential Bindfall
description: A quick crossing step swaps the thrower's two tracks and leaves the foe facing the wrong cord.

name: Unassailable Cordfork
description: Two cords held parallel before the body form a lane that stops a thrust from entering.

name: Wrapupdurance
description: Two cords run side by side around the legs and qi locks them as one binding.

name: Ponderous Shackle
description: The tracks cross behind the foe and one steady haul brings him down on his back.

name: Radiant Stonehead
description: A single glance shows which of the foe's two sides is open and which cord should strike it.

name: Gnashing Cordfork
description: Both weights arc in from opposite sides and strike the target at the same instant.

name: Bolawrath
description: The thrower casts down one track, switches to the other, strikes, and then closes both tracks upon the foe.

name: Thorn Fetter
description: Two qi-laden tracks join about the foe and keep tightening until his strength to resist fades.

name: Headlong Hobble
description: Both arms lift the weights high overhead as the thrower rises onto the toes.

name: Wrathful Wrapup
description: The weights are loosed from above the head and plunge steeply onto the target.

name: Torrential Ballsling
description: The thrower drops from the toes into a firm landing step that carries the throw's force into the ground.

name: Thornstone
description: A weight dropped from above carries the cord down around the target's leg and qi seats the wrap.

name: Equipoise Knotcenter
description: The cords lift in a quick updraft and turn a downward cut aside before it lands.

name: Stonevigil
description: The thrower keeps the sky above the field in view and marks every thrown object that falls.

name: Granite Joinknot
description: The cords are thrown high and fall as a net upon every foe in the drop.

name: Deed Tripcord
description: A charged cord is rigged high and drops when a foe passes beneath, tangling his shoulders and arms.

name: Ironhobble
description: A falling weight punches through the guard and drives the cord about both legs in one stroke.

name: Torrent Heavyball
description: The thrower faces the wind with the weights hung low so the cords never tangle on the thrower.

name: Corroding Whirlcast
description: The cast goes down one sworn line from hand to mark with no curve or hesitation.

name: Inexorable Ballsling
description: The cords whip in a sheet before the thrower and break up thrown sand and small stones.

name: Numbing Bolaweight
description: The thrower lets the wind bend the cords around the target's legs.

name: Enthralling Joinknot
description: The thrower holds the bearing and hauls steadily no matter how the quarry lunges and strains.

name: Veritystone
description: The thrower reads the gait of a plateau runner for the instant when the cast will land.

name: Gyve Whirlcast
description: A sworn cast thrown into the wind curves back and closes on the target's ankles.

name: Merciless Cordthree
description: With the wind and a deep qi release, the weights travel past ordinary range to strike a far mark.

name: Escalating Spindle
description: A sworn chain of cast, haul and strike runs on the gale's rhythm without a break between its parts.

name: Strangling Whirlcast
description: The cast rides the wind round every guard and the cords seize the target with piercing force.

name: Mighthobble
description: The thrower stands as a plateau runner stands at the oath-line, ready to go in any direction.

name: Rumble Ballsling
description: The thrower keeps the sworn pace of a runner and casts without breaking stride.

name: Thorn Bolaweight
description: The thrower leans far back on the cord and uses body weight to hold a straining quarry.

name: Overpowering Hobble
description: The thrower swears to hold the wrap and qi cinches it past what a plain cord could bear.

name: Shackle Vortex
description: A sure sprint along the plateau's lip carries the thrower round the foe's flank.

name: Equipoise Heavyball
description: A fast whirl of the cords in open air turns aside a spear point and a slashing blade.

name: Silt Cordthree
description: A line laid and sworn to hold is pegged low and springs tight about a foe's ankles.

name: Siltwrapup
description: The weights circle wide across open ground and trip every runner crossing their path.

name: Gyve Tripcord
description: The cords close and the sworn oath holds them, so the foe's strength cannot work against the binding.

name: Silt Joinknot
description: With no wall at the back the thrower stands with weight on both feet and eyes on the full horizon.

name: Chime Wrapup
description: The thrower takes a bearing on a distant mark and casts along it without checking the aim.

name: Wrapupspine
description: A flick of the tail along the open flank breaks the grip of a foe who rushes in.

name: Acute Spindle
description: The thrower turns slowly in place to hold every approach in view before the throw.

name: Might Knotcenter
description: A quick sidestep takes the thrower out of the gust's push and the foe's line of attack together.

name: Cordfork Fortitude
description: The cast keeps its bearing in flight and the qi locks the wrap the moment it closes.

name: Stonespine
description: A long steady haul draws a snared foe across open ground to the thrower's feet.

name: Charter Stonehead
description: The cords whirl above the thrower's head and keep a falling rain of stones from landing.

name: Daybreak Bolaweight
description: A broad whirl clears the open ground around the thrower of every foe the cords can reach.

name: Charter Joinknot
description: Many cords are pegged along one bearing across the plain and trip every runner who crosses it.

name: Strangling Spindle Fortitude
description: One vast sweep of qi-laden cords binds several foes at once and leaves them hauled together.

name: Silt Shackle
description: The thrower leans into the gale with weights low and rides each gust's push without stumbling.

name: Hellish Heavyball
description: The release is timed to the peak of a gust so the weights fly faster than a plain throw.

name: Blazebola
description: The loose cord is whipped crackling in the wind across the opponent's exposed hands.

name: Gyve Ballsling
description: The gale bends the cast in a curve around a guard and qi closes the wrap on the legs.

name: Equipoise Tripcord
description: The weights ride an updraft in a quick whirl that carries a sword stroke harmlessly high.

name: Fetter Glimmer
description: The thrower steps to the lee of a gust and arrives where the foe cannot cast back.

name: Lacerating Cordfork
description: The cast rides a strong gale far beyond the usual reach and wraps a distant target.

name: Fastening Cordthree
description: A charged cord pegged along the gale's path trips a runner who comes down it.

name: Bindfall Fortitude
description: A cast bent by qi and gale around any guard pierces the leg's defenses and binds the limb.

name: Granite Knotcenter
description: The thrower stands square to the horizon, weights hanging, until the quarry breaks into view.

name: Veritybola
description: The thrower reads a far dust plume for the runner's pace and heading.

name: Gnashing Whirlcast
description: A cast sworn to a far horizon mark leaves the hand with a sharp and settled release.

name: Thorn Bindfall
description: Hand over hand the thrower hauls a distant snared quarry steadily across the ground.

name: Hobblevalor
description: A cast marked by oath finds the legs and qi pulls the cords tight on the first contact.

name: Wrapup Devastation
description: A high long lob from the ridge drops the weights on a runner far across the plain.

name: Murk Cordthree
description: The cords turn a flung stone on the lee side of the thrower and send it rattling past.

name: Granite Fetter
description: A wide flung circle of cords tangles every runner who crosses the thrower's near horizon.

name: Malignant Heavyball
description: A single sworn line of pegged cords crosses the plain and trips whatever runs over it.

name: Fastening Bindfall
description: The sworn cast overtakes the quarry at the horizon and the qi-laden cords drain its strength to keep running.

name: Torrent Hobble
description: The thrower stands on a bearing taken far ahead, body and cords set in a single long line.

name: Revitalizing Spindle
description: The thrower counts paces along the bearing to the target and sets the cast to match.

name: Berserk Shackle
description: A long smooth cast follows the bearing to a target at the far edge of the cord.

name: Chime Joinknot
description: Holding the bearing, the thrower knocks aside an incoming thrown weapon with the cord's free end.

name: Ponderous Tripcord
description: Leaning into the line, the thrower uses the whole body to haul a quarry down.

name: Orbmettle
description: A cast along the bearing snares whoever crosses the line, and qi sets the wrap.

name: Might Cordfork
description: The thrower holds the bearing at a run and keeps the quarry at the cast's far end.

name: Hoarfrost Wrapup
description: The thrower swears the cord will hold and keeps a steady qi-fed tension against a foe's strength.

name: Obdurate Knotcenter
description: The cord's bearing reverses in a flash and casts a thrown blade aside before it lands.

name: Daybreak Ballsling
description: The whirling weights cover the whole of the thrower's ground and drop every foe who steps in.

name: Novastone
description: Charged cords are pegged along the whole bearing and snare everything that crosses the line.

name: Enthralling Bindfall
description: The qi-laden cords hold the foe along the entire bearing and press down his power as long as the line holds.
